data.title: 莲华 · 散落和服下的初次解禁
data.description: 华贵的金丝腰带被彻底扯开，层叠的绯红和服在榻榻米上铺散成一朵盛开的彼岸花。一贯从容优雅的引路人此刻双颊绯红，十指死死抓紧席面，在狂乱的侵入下彻底融化。
data.location: grand traditional tatami suite with gold leaf painted screens and unrolled futon
data.action: 一贯从容优雅的引路人此刻双颊绯红，十指死死抓紧席面，在狂乱的侵入下彻底融化
data.lighting: warm floor lantern illuminating flush across bare collarbones and silky raven hair spread wide
data.promptProse: Sprawled across a grand tatami suite framed by gold-leaf folding screens at night, Renge lies amidst the unfolded crimson silk and untied gold-brocade obi of her floral kimono, chest and thighs laid bare. Clutching the woven straw mat as her cool poise melts into heavy blush and breathless parted lips, she glows in warm floor-lantern light.
data.animaCaption: Sprawled back on the tatami amidst the unfolded vermilion silk and untied gold obi of her spider-lily kimono, she grips the woven mat with trembling fingers, heavily flushed and gasping through parted lips. Warm floor-lantern light glows against the painted gold-leaf screens.
data.nsfwProse: Her opulent vermilion spider-lily silk kimono and gold-brocade obi are untied and spread wide open across the tatami, baring her chest, stomach, and thighs.
